summary: Accepted after independent review of the exact nine-operation allusion repair. In s0054, 袁、許之術 is Zhao Yanyi’s comparison of skill, not a life event for Yuan Tiangang or Xu Fu; in s0200, 郤克之疾 is an allusive description of Zhang Yanchao’s lameness, not Xi Ke’s activity. The candidate removes only the invented personal chronology and paired active hints, adds explicitly classified undated retrospective references, and preserves the source-backed identity, skill, role, evidence, and non-temporal allusive facts.

sourceEvidence.quote: 光鄴膚革肥皙，善於攝養，故司天監趙延乂有袁、許之術，嘗謂人曰：「翟君外厚而內薄，雖貴而無壽。」

reviewedChanges.reason: 袁、許之術 grammatically qualifies Zhao Yanyi’s divinatory method. It does not describe an event in Yuan Tiangang’s life, so removing the invented AD 617–627 attestation and retaining a date-free retrospective reference is source-faithful.

sourceEvidence.quote: 光鄴膚革肥皙，善於攝養，故司天監趙延乂有袁、許之術，嘗謂人曰：「翟君外厚而內薄，雖貴而無壽。」

reviewedChanges.reason: The same paired allusion invokes Xu Fu as a traditional exemplar of physiognomy rather than reporting a personal event. The candidate retains the non-temporal reference and removes the invented BC 200–180 chronology.

sourceEvidence.quote: 素有郤克之疾，時號為「跛子」。

reviewedChanges.reason: 郤克之疾 is a classical allusive disease-name attached to Zhang Yanchao’s lameness. It supplies no dated activity by Xi Ke, so the candidate’s date-free retrospective-reference classification is required and preserves the source fact.
